Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

phone number — the digits you call to reach a person. Example: My phone number is 555 0182.
mobile — a telephone you carry. Example: My mobile is in my bag.
email — a message you send by computer. Example: Send me an email, please.
address — the place where you live. Example: What is your address?
street — a road with houses in a town. Example: I live in Green Street.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is your phone number?
• My email is...
• Where do you live?
• What is your address?
• Could you repeat the number?

Grammar focus: Possessive adjectives, question words (What, Where).
Question words: What is your phone number? Where do you live? Who is your teacher? Possessives: my mobile, your email.
